JAINA_CARD_ARCANE_ARTIFICER_CARD.title: Arcane Artificer
JAINA_CARD_ARCANE_ARTIFICER_CARD.descrip: Summon a [blue]1/3[/blue] [red]Arcane Artificer[/red]. Whenever you play a [blue]Spell card[/blue], gain Block equal to its cost.
JAINA_CARD_ANTONIDAS_CARD.title: Archmage Antonidas

JAINA_CARD_ROMMATH_CARD.title: Archmage Rommath
JAINA_CARD_ROMMATH_CARD.description: Summon a [blue]5/7[/blue] [red]Archmage Rommath[/red]. Battlecry: Recast every [blue]Spell card[/blue] from outside your deck that you have cast this combat (targets chosen randomly).
JAINA_CARD_MOZAKI_CARD.title: Mozaki Master of Flame
JAINA_CARD_MOZAKI_CARD.description: Summon a [blue]3/8[/blue] [red]Mozaki Master of Flame[/red]. After you cast a [blue]Spell card[/blue], gain +1 Strength.
JAINA_CARD_LUNA_CARD.title: Stargazer Luna
JAINA_CARD_LUNA_CARD.description: Summon a [blue]2/4[/blue] [red]Stargazer Luna[/red]. After you play the rightmost card in your hand, draw a card.
JAINA_CARD_KALECGOS_CARD.title: Kalecgos
JAINA_CARD_KALECGOS_CARD.description: Summon a [blue]4/12[/blue] [red]Kalecgos[/red]. The first [blue]Spell card[/blue] you play each turn costs 0. Battlecry: Discover a [blue]Spell card[/blue].
JAINA_CARD_AEGWYNN_CARD.title: Aegwynn the Guardian
JAINA_CARD_AEGWYNN_CARD.description: Summon a [blue]5/5[/blue] [red]Aegwynn the Guardian[/red]. +2 Strength. Deathrattle: The next minion card you draw inherits this ability.
JAINA_CARD_REWIND.title: Rewind
JAINA_CARD_REWIND.description: Discover a copy of another [blue]Spell card[/blue] you have cast this combat.
JAINA_CARD_TRICK.title: Trick
JAINA_CARD_TRICK.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Discover two [blue]Spell cards[/blue] that cost 1 or less. Swap their costs.|Discover a [blue]Spell card[/blue] that costs 1 or less.}
JAINA_CARD_UNFAIR_GAME.title: Unfair Game
JAINA_CARD_UNFAIR_GAME.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Draw three [blue]Spell cards[/blue]. [blue]Finale[/blue]: Discover a copy from among them.|If you took no damage this turn, draw three cards next turn.}
JAINA_CARD_NORGANNON_WISDOM.title: Norgannon's Wisdom
JAINA_CARD_NORGANNON_WISDOM.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Draw 2 cards. Gain 1 energy for each [blue]Spell card[/blue] drawn.|Draw 2 cards. If you have cast a [blue]Spell card[/blue] from the Fire, Arcane and Frost schools this combat, this card costs 0.}

{IfUpgraded:show:Discover a [blue]Spell card[/blue]. It costs 1 less.
[blue]Finisher[/blue]: At the start of your next turn, return this card to your hand.|Discover a [blue]Spell card[/blue]. It costs 1 less.}
